policy_name: FieldIQ Tactical Decision Costs & Risk Utilities
description: Formalized asymmetric loss and tactical decision cost functions. Separates domain coaching policy and tactical utility from predictive model outputs in compliance with AGENTS.md Rule 2 and Rule 17.

missing_wicket_opportunity.rationale: High cost of failing to position catching fielders when a genuine edge or dismissal opportunity occurs (loss of wicket value in T20).

falsely_declaring_wicket_opportunity.rationale: Cost of over-attacking (e.g., maintaining an unnecessary slip or close-in catcher that yields easy boundary/gap runs).

missing_boundary_threat.rationale: Cost of leaving a high-risk sector unguarded on the boundary, resulting in a conceded 4 or 6.

falsely_declaring_boundary_threat.rationale: Cost of deploying an unnecessary boundary rider, leaving the inner ring open and conceding easy singles/strike rotation.

conceding_boundary.rationale: Direct scoring penalty for boundary conceded.

conceding_single.rationale: Direct scoring penalty for single conceded.

failing_to_create_pressure.rationale: Cost of failing to choke strike rotation during a dot-ball sequence.
